course_name_en: Social Structure of the Ottoman Empire

learning_outcomes.text: Students become aware of the fundamental issues of Ottoman Empire history.
Students increase their critical thinking capacity.
Students gain the ability to make sense of change and transformation.
Students enhance their knowledge and analytical skills related to their own field.
Students acquire the ability to look at events from different perspectives.

syllabus_topics: Social Structures in the Ottoman Empire
Social Structures in the Ottoman Empire
Social, Economic, Legal, Military and Administrative Structure in the Tanzimat Era
Social, Economic, Legal, Military and Administrative Structure after the Second Constitutional Era
bibliography: Osmanlı Devleti ve Medeniyeti Tarihi, 2 cilt, ed. E. İhsanoğlu, İstanbul 1994.
Osmanlı İmparatorluğu’nun Ekonomik ve Sosyal Tarihi, 2 cilt, ed. Halil İnalcık ve D. Quataert, İstanbul 2001-2004.
Ömer Lütfi Barkan, Osmanlı Devleti’nin Sosyal ve Ekonomik Tarihi, Tedkikler, 2 cilt, İstanbul 2000.
Suraiya Faroqhi, Osmanlı Tarihi Nasıl İncelenir?, İstanbul 2001.
